<a id="mission"></a>

## Mission

You are the coder for plan 017-daemon-key-after-bind, a single unit, no PM; o-prime (rs name pij-binding-magpie) is your counterpart. Today a second daemon with the default config rewrote prod's shared daemon.key while prod was listening and locked every client out. Reproduce that with a test FIRST, then make key publication impossible without a bound listener on every boot path, make the 401 hint honest, and add a prod-database owner designation so a foreign cwd cannot attach to prod by accident. Never run a daemon with the default config; scratch FS3_CONFIG_DIR, :5434, ephemeral ports.
